title: Crow's Nest

scenario.title: Generated copy picks the wrong article
scenario.body: The book's rule is spelling: a vowel letter takes "an". Real copy ("You unlocked a/an ___ badge") is judged by sound: an hour, a unicorn, an FBI agent, an 8-ball. Make these pass without breaking any of the author's tests.

tagline: Polly sits at the top of the mast and shouts what she spots. Her only job: say "a" or "an" correctly.

brain_blurbs.book: Follows the book's rule: a, e, i, o or u means "an".
brain_blurbs.real: Listens to how the word sounds.

rules.test_usage: Polly explains herself when you ask for help
rules.test_consonant_upper: …even when the word Starts With A Capital
rules.test_silent_h: "An hour", not "a hour" (the h is shy)
rules.test_initialisms: "An FBI agent" (say the letters out loud!)
rules.test_still_a_plain_vowel: Still gets octopus and narwhal right
